actions.action: Replace the shared spreadsheet with a placement-only export
actions.mechanism: Separate private requirements from attendee-visible placements; hiding columns does not remove sensitive data.
actions.implementation: Restrict the working sheet to seating staff. Generate a separate attendee list containing only attendee identifiers, tables, and seats; revoke old sharing links.
actions.check: Using an attendee account, verify accommodation notes, requirement flags, comments, revision history, and the original sheet are inaccessible.
actions.risk: Previously downloaded copies cannot be recalled reliably.

actions.action: Allocate clear-route seats before trying to seat pairs
actions.mechanism: Treat the four eligible seats as scarce capacity; pair preferences never override hard requirements.
actions.implementation: Mark exactly four seats eligible. Assign required placements first, preserve confirmed placements, then optimize pairs. Queue excess access requests without requesting medical details.
actions.check: Test five access requests: flag insufficient capacity. Test a late pair with only separated seats: offer those seats without displacing access placements.
actions.risk: A seating algorithm cannot create additional accessible capacity.

actions.action: Require a protected change process for confirmed placements
actions.mechanism: Versioned updates and a contact gate prevent cancellations or concurrent edits from silently removing confirmed accessible placements.
actions.implementation: Record confirmation status. Block removal or relocation until attendee contact is logged; log agreed changes. Preview changes, revalidate requirements, then publish one version.
actions.check: Simulate cancellation, bulk reshuffling, and stale edits. Confirm protected placements remain without contact, and stale updates cannot overwrite newer assignments.
actions.risk: Contact delays may leave seats temporarily unavailable for reassignment.
